research.name: sabiql
research.note: Vim-keyed terminal client for PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite that shows a diff, the SQL and a risk level before applying an edit.

effects: confirm dialog before a cell edit showing risk level, value diff and SQL preview
key hint footer that changes with the focused pane and mode
SQL editor modal with table name completion popup over the dimmed panes
focus mode that expands the result grid to the full screen
ER diagram of foreign keys rendered with Graphviz and opened in the browser
